name: litellm-key
description: See your LiteLLM virtual key inside Claude Code: budget, spend pace and allowance, limits, expiry, models and usage, in tabs, with commands for scripts.

litellm_url.title: LiteLLM proxy URL
litellm_url.description: Leave empty to use ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, the proxy Claude Code already talks to.

litellm_key.title: LiteLLM virtual key
litellm_key.description: Leave empty to use the key Claude Code already sends (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or the x-litellm-api-key custom header).

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often the key is re-read from the proxy.

daily_alert.title: Daily spend alert ($)
daily_alert.description: Warn once today's spend on the key reaches this many dollars (toast once a day, the status line and the pane). 0 turns it off. Needs the usage history; with it on, the history is read every 3 minutes.

warn_percent.title: Budget warning (%)
warn_percent.description: Show a toast once the key has used this much of its budget (it also warns at 95% and 100%).

show_status_line.title: Status line
show_status_line.description: Pin a one-line budget summary under the prompt.

show_related.title: User and team budgets
show_related.description: Also read /user/info and /team/info, since those budgets can block requests too.

show_usage.title: Usage history
show_usage.description: Also read /user/daily/activity for the last 30 days of spend, requests and tokens, by day and by model (beta endpoint).

show_toasts.title: Warning toasts
show_toasts.description: Show the toasts that warn about the budget, the pace, the daily alert, an expiring key and a proxy that fails. Off keeps the warnings to the status line, the pane and /litellm check.

status_bar.title: Status line meter
status_bar.description: Start the status line with a small meter of the budget: ▰▰▰▰▱▱ 83% of budget. Off keeps the text alone.

show_forecast.title: Spend forecast
show_forecast.description: Say where the spend is heading: the pace in the pane, when the budget would run out in the status line, and a warning when that is before it resets.

compact_pane.title: Compact pane
compact_pane.description: In a terminal too narrow for the table, draw the pane above the prompt compact: one line per meter, the facts side by side, as short as it can be. Off keeps the roomier layout.
